maddeler.e:
تلتقطي (form VIII)
# تَلْتَقِطِي (taltaqiṭī) /tal.ta.qi.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# تُلْتَقَطِي (tultaqaṭī) /tul.ta.qa.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
